AMDRadeonRDNA4.kext (BSD 3-Clause)
https://github.com/RX4Darwin/AMDRadeonRDNA4.kext
Reference upstream revision: `next` @ dded456d (Copyright (c) 2026 Sunneva N. Mariu)

Garnet adapts and derives the following non-Lilu modules, hardware discoveries,
and Mesa/user-space components from AMDRadeonRDNA4.kext under the BSD 3-Clause
license reproduced below (zero Lilu hooks, zero AppleParavirtGPU production
paths, and zero GPL-2.0 QEMU files are included):
- Wave 1 (implemented):
  * Navi 44 (RX 9060 XT) ODM_MEM_PWR_CTRL2 (seg2:0x1e2f) read-hazard discovery
    and exclusion (`src/dcn41/`, `tools/dcn41/gen_allow.py`,
    `src/garnet/src/dcn/{dcn41_modeset.h,dispread_flow.h}`, upstream PR #17
    `docs/emu-linux.md`).
  * CoreDisplay `AMD*` framebuffer class-prefix vendor classification
    (`AMDGarnetPrimaryFramebuffer` and `src/garnet-metal/rdna4_coredisplay_compat.h`,
    upstream commit `b4751220`).
  * DCN 4.01 128x128 hardware cursor register programming and pixel packing
    (`src/garnet/src/dcn/dcn41_cursor_pure.h` and `AMDGarnetPrimaryFramebuffer`
    cursor hooks, adapted from `src/cursor.cpp`, upstream commits `95b0b43a`,
    `52af5417`).
  * Mesa RADV `VK_EXT_metal_surface` WSI fallback and MoltenVK-to-RADV app
    wrapper (`mesa-patches/0026-radv-darwin-windows-through-VK_EXT_metal_surface.patch`
    and `tools/rdna4/radv-app.sh`, upstream commits `6811730c`, `f069d9bf`).
- Wave 2 (implemented):
  * VMID exact TLB sequence acknowledgement, quarantine, and sparse page-table
    rollback (`src/garnet/src/amd/{rdna4_vmid_pool.h,rdna4_sparse_pt_pure.h}`,
    adapted from `src/vmid.hpp` and `src/runtime.cpp`, upstream commits
    `87fe681e`, `e5c09ce2`, `e106dc56`, `7401ff36`, `45645d61`, `4282415a`).
  * Non-Lilu S3 system sleep/wake and DP DDC-to-AUX pad recovery
    (`src/garnet/src/amd/rdna4_sleep_pure.h`,
    `src/garnet/src/dcn/dcn41_ddc_pad_pure.h`,
    `src/garnet/src/GarnetDriver.{hpp,cpp}`,
    `src/garnet/src/GarnetPrimaryFramebuffer.{hpp,cpp}`, adapted from
    `src/device.cpp`, upstream commits `50a0fd1f`, `bb4c5145`, `aefc2385`,
    `dded456d`).
  * Standalone OpenGL-on-Metal drawable bridge and unaligned vertex fetch /
    encoder compatibility (`src/garnet-metal/{rdna4_gl_surface_pure.h,
    rdna4_gl_drawable_impl.inc,GarnetDevice.m,rdna4_command_buffer_impl.inc,
    rdna4_render_encoder_impl.inc}`, adapted from
    `tools/metal/native/RDNA4MTLDevice.mm`, upstream commit `1a034e6a`;
    `glProgramAir` and `AppleParavirtGPU` paths intentionally excluded).

Note: `third-party/amdradeonrdna4-kext/` was previously retired during
`establish-garnet-architecture`, while the historical `7aa397b522e335ed5607f601a64e4a3a401dfa9a`
reference in RDNA4FB/AMDRadeonRDNA4 remains covered by the same BSD 3-Clause terms:
